# Eternal Potions — Changelog

## Version 1.1.0 — Waypoints & Commands Update

### Added

- **Locator bar waypoints** for every active Eternal brew — visible at any distance, in any dimension, no recovery compass required.
- **Live brew timer** above each waypoint in `M:SS` format. Moves with the sprite as the player rotates. Hides when the sprite would fall off the visible bar.
- **Version check** — clients with a mismatched mod version are disconnected during the play phase with a message telling them which version to install.
- **`/eternal stand start <pos>`** — spawns a brewing stand at the position with blaze powder, a water bottle, and an Eternal Shard pre-loaded. Auto-starts the brew. First attempt in an unloaded chunk is refused; a second attempt at the same position force-loads the chunk.
- **`/eternal item <player> <shard|potion> <quantity>`** — grants 1 to 64 of either Eternal item.

### Changed

- **Eternal Strength, Regeneration, and Resistance now match vanilla values exactly.**
  - Eternal Strength — +3 / +6 / +9 attack damage.
  - Eternal Regeneration — heal every 50 / 25 / 12 ticks.
  - Eternal Resistance — 20% / 40% / 60% damage reduction.
- **Eternal Speed rebalanced** to +15% / +25% / +40% movement. Lower than vanilla on purpose to keep the FOV swing readable at higher levels.
- **Vanilla Speed, Strength, Regeneration, and Resistance are halved** while this mod is loaded:
  - Vanilla Speed — +10% per level.
  - Vanilla Strength — +1.5 damage per level.
  - Vanilla Regeneration — heal every 100 / 50 / 25 ticks.
  - Vanilla Resistance — 10% per level.
- **`/eternal effect take`** now drops one level at a time: III → II → I → gone. Refuses on Kings and directs the operator to `/eternal king dethrone`. Refuses on players who don't have the effect.
- **Command tree reorganised** into four subgroups: `stand`, `effect`, `king`, and `item`.
- **Disconnect messages shortened** to a two-line format.

### Removed

- `/eternal king list` — the `/kings` menu supersedes it.
- Flat commands `/eternal stop`, `/eternal give`, `/eternal take` — replaced by their nested equivalents.
- Configuration-phase disconnect for version mismatch — this caused raw socket errors on the client. Version checks now run in the play phase and produce a clean Disconnect screen.

### Fixed

- **Welcome message no longer re-fires after a server restart.** The state file is force-flushed when a first-join welcome triggers.
- **Brew waypoint icons now appear.** Fixed a registration order bug where the transmitter was tracked before the brew was marked active, causing the waypoint manager to skip it.
- **Locator bar timer follows the sprite correctly.** The `int` argument in the locator bar's drawing callback is the bar's top Y, not the sprite's X. The X is recomputed from yaw in the mixin to match vanilla's own positioning.
- **`/eternal stand stop` now clears the brew's waypoint** from every player's locator bar when the stand is destroyed.
- **Eternal Shard and Eternal Potion are fireproof** — dying in lava no longer destroys them.
- **A player with any Eternal effect now always drops an Eternal Shard on death** (was 50%).
- **Brewing stand no longer discards potions** when the shard is added with multiple bottle slots filled.
- **Shard cannot be inserted into a stand** unless a valid potion is present.
- **KingsScreen font no longer doubles** and effect names are outlined for readability.

### Commands (OP Required)

- `/eternal stand stop <pos>` — stops a brew, drops contents, destroys the stand.
- `/eternal stand start <pos>` — spawns a pre-loaded brewing stand and starts the brew.
- `/eternal effect give <player> <effect>` — grants one level. Third grant crowns the player.
- `/eternal effect take <player> <effect>` — drops one level at a time.
- `/eternal king crown <player> <effect>` — force-crowns a player.
- `/eternal king dethrone <effect>` — removes the current King.

...

# Eternal Potions — Changelog

## Version 1.0.0 — Initial Release

### Items

- Added **Eternal Shard** — brewing ingredient, fireproof.
- Added **The Eternal Potion** — consumable, fireproof, stacks to 1.
- Both items added to creative tabs (Eternal Shard in Ingredients, Eternal Potion in Food & Drinks).

### Effects

- Added four custom effects, each with three levels:
  - **Eternal Speed** — movement speed boost (I/II/III).
  - **Eternal Strength** — attack damage boost (I/II/III).
  - **Eternal Regeneration** — periodic healing (I/II/III).
  - **Eternal Resistance** — damage reduction, capped at 80% total (I/II/III).
- HUD icons show Roman numerals for every level, including Level I.
- All effects are permanent until death.
- Effects survive world reloads, dimension changes, and server restarts.

### The King System

- Four thrones — one per effect — held by the first player to reach Level III.
- Only one King per effect at a time.
- Kings receive a crown particle effect and are announced server-wide when crowned.
- Kings keep their throne while offline.
- Thrones persist across server restarts.
- Dying as a King empties the throne and announces the fall.
- Server-wide announcement when all four thrones are claimed.
- Special announcement when a single player holds all four thrones.

### Brewing

- Brewing an Eternal Potion takes **10 minutes** (12000 ticks).
- The brewing stand locks completely during a brew:
  - No GUI interaction.
  - No item insertion or extraction.
  - No breaking the block.
- Server-wide broadcast when a brew starts and when it stops.
- All bottle slots consolidate to the center slot at brew start.
- The Eternal Shard cannot be inserted unless a valid potion is present.
- `/eternal stop <x> <y> <z>` command destroys a brew and drops its contents.

### Protection

- **Totem of Undying** preserves all Eternal effects and the throne on pop.
- **Milk** does not remove Eternal effects.
- **Vanilla Speed, Regeneration, Resistance, and Strength** are blocked while you have the corresponding Eternal effect. You are notified when a vanilla effect is blocked.
- **Death drops an Eternal Shard 100% of the time** if the player had any Eternal effect.

### Commands (OP Required)

- `/eternal give <player> <effect>` — grants one level.
- `/eternal take <player> <effect>` — removes an effect.
- `/eternal king crown <player> <effect>` — force-crowns a player.
- `/eternal king dethrone <effect>` — removes the current King.
- `/eternal king list` — lists all current Kings.
- `/eternal stop <x> <y> <z>` — stops a brew and destroys the stand.
- `/kings` — client command, opens the Kings leaderboard menu.

### Kings Menu (`/kings`)

- Beveled vanilla-style panel with rounded corners.
- Pixel-art gold crown next to the title.
- Effect slots with colored tiles.
- Effect names color-coded per effect with black outlines.
- King names right-aligned to the panel edge.
- "Thrones Claimed: N/4" footer.

### Welcome Message

- First-time players receive a 3-page chat message spread 3 seconds apart.
- Page 1 — intro and goal.
- Page 2 — brewing and hunting.
- Page 3 — domains and victory.
- Message fires only on first join; persists across server restarts.
- Uses `%player%` placeholder for the player's name.

### Server Gate

- Clients without the mod are kicked during the configuration phase, before vanilla registry sync errors.
- Kick message includes a clickable link to the Modrinth page.

### Localization

- English (US, UK variants, Pirate Speak, Shakespearean, Upside-Down).
- German, Spanish, French, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese (Brazil), Russian, Swedish, Turkish, Urdu (Pakistan), Chinese (Simplified).

### Recipes

- **Eternal Shard** — shaped crafting recipe using Ominous Trial Key, Heart of the Sea, Ender Eye, Echo Shard, Totem of Undying, and Enchanted Golden Apple.
- **Eternal Potion** — brewing recipe using an Eternal Shard as the ingredient.
